text: The authors state that logical flaws in the examiner's operation are likely to affect the whole examination and can lead to inaccurate decisions, though the method still helps on average. They name developing safety mechanisms that detect and mitigate such logical flaws as future work.
title: Logical flaws in the examiner can lead to wrong decisions
